verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at help.shopify.com (HTTP 200) that describes itself as a "guide for AI agents and crawlers." The help-center and shopify.dev POS pages are also served as .md markdown URLs (e.g., sell-in-person.md, apps/build/pos.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable docs. The .md.md 404 probe used a malformed double extension and does not count against this. Missing for 10: a POS-specific llms.txt or agent guide (the file found covers the whole Shopify Help Center), visibility of the llms.txt content beyond its header, and independent or community confirmation that agents use these docs effectively.
